# Qbits Spanish Water Dog Kennel — Complete Knowledge Base (Upper East Side, NYC)

## 1. Overview, Breeder Background & Service Dog Philosophy
Qbits Spanish Water Dog Kennel is a boutique, home-raised preservation and service animal breeding program located on the Upper East Side of New York City, New York. We specialize exclusively in the **Spanish Water Dog** (*Perro de Agua Español*), an ancient Iberian herding and water retriever breed celebrated for its rustic, non-shedding curly/corded coat, high intelligence, deep human attunement, and compact athletic strength.

### Unique Value Proposition (UVP)
Our kennel is led by **by far the youngest Spanish Water Dog preservation breeder**, combining next-generation genetic health screening with extensive professional experience training and working with task-trained service dogs through our training company, **[Gotham Paw](https://gothampaw.netlify.app/services/service-animal/)**.

### Why We Specialize in Service Animals Instead of AKC Conformation Shows
At least **one puppy from every Qbits litter is transferred directly into our Service Animal Program**. This is why we do not regularly campaign our dogs at weekend AKC conformation events—our dogs are proven in real-world medical service work. Specifically, we focus on **task-trained service animals for people with spinal cord injuries (SCI) and neuromuscular/neurological disorders** (such as **Cerebral Palsy (CP), Multiple Sclerosis (MS), ALS, and peripheral neuropathies** where there is a neurological component). Prospective service dog clients are encouraged to reach out to us at `dog@cmejo.com` **as soon as possible**, as evaluating, matching, and custom task-training a service dog to our standards is a very thorough, multi-stage process.

### Service Dog vs. Therapy Dog vs. Emotional Support Animal (ESA)
Many of our dogs also go to homes where they work as certified **Therapy Dogs**, and we educate every prospective client on the legal and functional differences:
1. **Task-Trained Service Dog (Medical Equipment under the ADA)**: Under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), a service dog is legally classified as a piece of **medical equipment**—comparable to a power wheelchair or medical alert device. It is individually task-trained to mitigate a person's diagnosed physical or neurological disability (e.g., retrieving dropped items, operating door buttons, deep pressure therapy for spasticity, counterbalance) and has full public-access rights everywhere its handler goes.
2. **Therapy Dog (Facility & Visitation Comfort)**: Trained and certified (e.g., AKC Therapy Dog, Alliance of Therapy Dogs, Pet Partners) to visit hospitals, rehabilitation clinics, nursing homes, and schools *by invitation* to bring comfort to many people. Therapy dogs do not have ADA public-access rights in non-pet businesses.
3. **Emotional Support Animal (ESA — Fair Housing Protection Only)**: An ESA is a pet prescribed by a licensed healthcare provider that provides comfort through companionship alone without task training. An ESA has **no public-access rights** in restaurants, stores, or public venues; legally, an ESA designation **only protects renters from being evicted or denied housing by a landlord that doesn't allow pets** under the federal Fair Housing Act (FHA).

## 2. Our Dogs

### Dudley — Stud Dog (Sire)
- **Call Name**: Dudley
- **Registered Name**: Qbits Iberian Quantum Leap
- **Role**: Resident Stud Dog & Sire of Planned Litters (Proven Service & Working Foundation)
- **Status**: Available for Stud Services to approved, health-tested Spanish Water Dog bitches.
- **Coat & Color**: Rich chocolate brown with rustic tight curls (carries brown/cream alleles).
- **Height & Weight**: 19.25 inches at the withers | 46 lbs (Balanced, athletic medium bone).
- **Health Clearances**:
  - OFA Hips: Good
  - OFA Elbows: Normal
  - OFA Eyes (CAER): Normal (Updated Annually)
  - prcd-PRA (Progressive Rod-Cone Degeneration): Clear / Normal
  - NAD (Neuroaxonal Dystrophy): Clear / Normal
  - CHG (Congenital Hypothyroidism with Goiter): Clear / Normal
  - OFA Thyroid & Cardiac: Normal

### Molly — Foundation Bitch (Dam)

- **Role**: Foundation Dam — Planned Litters Fall 2027 / Spring 2028 (Service & Therapy Producer)

## 3. Stud Services (Dudley)
Qbits Spanish Water Dog Kennel offers **Dudley** at stud to select, approved Spanish Water Dog bitches that have completed required OFA and genetic health clearances.
- **Options**: Natural breeding in the NYC/Tri-State area, fresh-chilled semen shipped overnight nationwide, or frozen semen.
- **Inquiries**: Contact `dog@cmejo.com` with your bitch's three-generation pedigree, OFA/CHIC health links, and timing estimate.

## 4. Planned Litters: Fall 2027 & Spring 2028 (Dudley × Molly)
We are planning our upcoming pairings between **Dudley** and **Molly** for **Fall 2027** and **Spring 2028**.
- **Rearing Protocol**: Raised underfoot in our Upper East Side NYC home using Puppy Culture and Early Neurological Stimulation (ENS), wheelchair/mobility equipment exposure, urban sound conditioning, crate training foundations, and water introduction.
- **Placement Process**: At least one puppy per litter is transferred into our [Gotham Paw](https://gothampaw.netlify.app/services/service-animal/) Service Animal Program; remaining puppies are matched with approved therapy and family companion homes at 7–8 weeks of age following structural and temperament evaluations.
- **How to Apply**:
  1. Complete our interactive online Application on our website (`https://qbits-swd.netlify.app/#puppy-application`), OR
  2. Download our fillable & printable PDF Application at `/qbits-puppy-application.pdf`, complete it digitally or by hand, and email or mail it in.
